summary: Install-time system info collection in install.cjs
details: install.cjs runs as a lifecycle script on package install and imports the `os` and `https` modules, reads values from `process.env`, and branches on `process.platform`. The shape is consistent with collecting host/environment information and sending it over HTTPS at install time. Without full tracing of the destination and payload, the exact fields transmitted and the receiving host are not confirmed from the available evidence.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
